body: ＊本次為 08/04–08/05 兩日合併掃描：08/04 排程未執行，已一併回補。臨床試驗雷達補收一筆：Synusight Biotech（上海）的 SST001 PET 造影劑第一期試驗（NCT07604116、收案中、2026/06/15 起始），n≈30 分健康受試者／MSA／帕金森氏症三組，評估安全性、耐受性、生物分佈、輻射劑量學與藥物動力學，站點在中國；此為造影工具而非治療藥物，與 MODAG [¹¹C]MODAG-005 同類收錄，惟公開登錄未載明標的分子，不予臆測。文獻雷達新增 2 篇：Magnetic Resonance Imaging 的定量磁化率造影（QSM）傘狀回顧指出殼核與蒼白球磁化率升高可有效區分 MSA、進行性核上性麻痺與原發性帕金森氏症；Frontiers in Immunology 以 149 人（PD 75、MSA-P 74）比較早期兩病的單核球發炎型態與紅血球 α-突觸核蛋白區室化差異（單中心、尚未獨立驗證，另有同期更正啟事）。CT.gov 兩日內其餘命中為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（risdiplam）等「atrophy」字面誤中及自律神經衰竭觀察性研究，不予收錄。

en.body: *This is a combined 04–05 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 04 August and has been backfilled here. One entry added to the trial radar: Synusight Biotech's (Shanghai) Phase 1 study of the PET imaging agent SST001 (NCT07604116, recruiting, started 2026/06/15), n≈30 across healthy volunteers, MSA and Parkinson's disease, assessing safety, tolerability, biodistribution, radiation dosimetry and pharmacokinetics at sites in China. This is an imaging tool rather than a therapeutic, recorded on the same basis as MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005; the public registration does not state the molecular target, and none is inferred here. Two papers added to the literature radar: an umbrella review in Magnetic Resonance Imaging finding that elevated quantitative susceptibility in the putamen and globus pallidus effectively separates MSA and progressive supranuclear palsy from idiopathic Parkinson's disease; and a study in Frontiers in Immunology comparing monocyte inflammatory profiles and erythrocyte alpha-synuclein compartmentalisation across 149 participants (75 PD, 74 MSA-P) in early disease (single-centre, not independently replicated, with a correction notice also published). The remaining CT.gov hits across the two days were literal 'atrophy' matches such as spinal muscular atrophy (risdiplam) plus an observational autonomic-failure study, and were not recorded.

body: 臨床試驗雷達補收一筆：MODAG 的 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 α-synuclein PET 放射配體先導試驗（NCT07640542、Early Ph1、收案中）。此案昨日已在領域焦點提及，但試驗雷達本身尚未建檔，今日補齊：n≈9，收 PD、MSA 病人與年齡配對健康對照，病人做兩次掃描、主要指標為注射後 4 天內安全性與耐受性並評估再測再現性，部分受試者在第二次掃描前口服 300 mg anle138b（emrusolmin）；單一站點為德國圖賓根大學醫院。此為造影／生物標記工具而非治療藥物，因 MSA 長期缺乏活體 α-synuclein 定量手段而收錄。CT.gov 近 7 天其餘命中為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（salanersen）等「atrophy」字面誤中，不予收錄；PubMed 近 7 天 4 篇 MSA 標題文獻均已在文獻雷達內。

en.body: One entry added to the trial radar: MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005 α-synuclein PET radioligand pilot (NCT07640542, Early Ph1, recruiting). The study was mentioned in yesterday's field focus but had no record on the trial radar itself, so it is filled in today: n≈9 across PD patients, MSA patients and age-matched healthy controls, with two scans for patients, safety and tolerability through 4 days post-injection as the primary endpoints alongside test-retest characteristics, and a subset receiving 300 mg oral anle138b (emrusolmin) before the second scan; the single site is Universitätsklinikum Tübingen in Germany. This is an imaging and biomarker tool rather than a therapeutic, recorded because MSA has long lacked a way to quantify α-synuclein in living patients. The remaining CT.gov hits from the past 7 days were literal 'atrophy' matches such as spinal muscular atrophy (salanersen) and were not recorded; all four MSA-titled PubMed papers from the past week were already on the literature radar.

body: 更新 α-synuclein PET 示蹤劑那則領域焦點：MODAG 的 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 再測信度先導研究已於 2026/07/29 啟動收案（NCT07640542，n=9、德國圖賓根大學醫院單中心，主要完成估 2027/07），原紀錄為「尚未收案」；同時依登錄資料校正 Synusight SST001 的起始日為 2026/06/15（原記為 2026/05）並補上站點與收案數。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見新的在研療法（其餘命中為 SMA／DMD／原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中）；PubMed 近 7 天 4 篇 MSA 標題文獻均已在文獻雷達內。

en.body: Updated the α-synuclein PET tracer field-focus entry: MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005 test-retest pilot opened to recruitment on 29 July 2026 (NCT07640542, n=9, single site at Tübingen University Hospital in Germany, primary completion estimated 2027/07), where the record previously read 'not yet recruiting'. The start date for Synusight's SST001 was corrected to 15 June 2026 from 2026/05 per the registry, with sites and enrolment added. The 7-day CT.gov sweep found no new MSA therapies in development — the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches such as SMA, DMD and primary ciliary dyskinesia — and all four MSA-titled PubMed papers from the past week were already on the literature radar.

body: 新增 1 則文獻：英國 ExPRESS 新發帕金森症候群前瞻世代研究計畫書（BMJ Open，UCL／劍橋／布里斯托／牛津，n=500，其中 120 人做深度生物標記）——文中指出 MSA 自症狀發生到診斷中位數 3.1 年、遠長於帕金森氏症的 1.0–1.2 年，該世代的目標之一即建立可供疾病修飾治療試驗使用的 trial-ready 族群。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見新的在研療法（Alterity ATH434-203 延伸試驗與 Teva TEV-56286 延伸試驗均已在列且狀態無變更；其餘命中為 SMA／原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中）。Alterity 2026/07/30 之 Q4 FY26 季報僅重述 7 月已收錄的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 樞紐設計，無新事實，故不另收。

en.body: Added one paper: the protocol for ExPRESS, a UK prospective cohort of incident parkinsonism (BMJ Open; UCL / Cambridge / Bristol / Oxford; n=500, with 120 undergoing deep biomarker assessment). It notes a median 3.1 years from symptom onset to diagnosis in MSA against 1.0–1.2 years in Parkinson's disease, and one of the cohort's aims is to build a trial-ready population for disease-modifying treatment studies. The 7-day CT.gov sweep found no new MSA therapies in development: Alterity's ATH434-203 extension and Teva's TEV-56286 extension are both already listed with unchanged status, and the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches such as SMA and primary ciliary dyskinesia. Alterity's Q4 FY26 quarterly report of 2026/07/30 only restates the FDA End-of-Phase-2 pivotal design already captured in July, so it was not recorded again.

body: 在研療法全景新增 Denali Therapeutics DNL422（OTV:SNCA）——以 TransportVehicle 平台穿越血腦障壁、直接靶向 α-synuclein，仍在 IND-enabling 階段、主打帕金森病；與 MSA 的關聯是機轉相鄰而非直接競爭（MSA 病灶在寡突膠細胞、帕金森在神經元）。另於總覽新增姊妹站連結：MSA 相關的細胞治療與 CDMO 生態系對象統一收錄於 SCA-IQ 的「合作機會」頁。

link.label: 詳見 在研療法全景 ↗

en.body: Added Denali Therapeutics' DNL422 (OTV:SNCA) to the therapy landscape — crossing the blood-brain barrier on the TransportVehicle platform and targeting alpha-synuclein directly, still IND-enabling and aimed at Parkinson's disease; its link to MSA is mechanistic adjacency rather than direct competition, since MSA pathology sits in oligodendrocytes and Parkinson's in neurons. A sister-site link was also added to the Overview: MSA-relevant cell therapy and CDMO counterparties are consolidated on SCA-IQ's Partnering tab.

body: 新增 1 則文獻：2022 MDS 診斷準則之姿勢性低血壓條件驗證（Eur Neurol，日本，n=451）——MDS 準則使 MSA 的姿勢性低血壓偵測率由 39.3% 升至 64.5%，但在帕金森病、路易體失智與純自主神經衰竭同樣大量命中；收縮壓過衝在 MSA 僅 6.5%，可能是鑑別線索。另新增 1 則領域焦點：盤點以 MSA 為目標族群的 α-synuclein PET 造影示蹤劑（MODAG [¹⁸F]MODAG-009／[¹¹C]MODAG-005、Synusight SST001）——屬造影示蹤劑非治療藥物，依準則不列入試驗雷達。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見在研療法新進者（其餘命中為 SMA／DMD／肌少症等「atrophy」字面誤中）。

en.body: Added 1 paper: a validation of the orthostatic-hypotension component of the 2022 MDS diagnostic criteria (Eur Neurol, Japan, n=451) — the MDS criteria raise detection of orthostatic hypotension in MSA from 39.3% to 64.5% but also flag large fractions of Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies and pure autonomic failure, while systolic overshoot occurs in only 6.5% of MSA and may serve as a differentiating clue. Also added one field item: a stocktake of α-synuclein PET tracers that include MSA as a target population (MODAG's [¹⁸F]MODAG-009 and [¹¹C]MODAG-005, Synusight's SST001) — these are imaging tracers rather than treatments, so per the inclusion rule they are not listed on the trial radar. The last 7 days of CT.gov MSA screening found no new investigational therapies; the remaining hits were literal false matches on "atrophy" from SMA, DMD and sarcopenia studies.

body: 新增 1 筆試驗：Alterity ATH434 開放標籤延伸試驗 ATH434-203（NCT07729852，2026/07 登錄）——僅供已完成 ATH434-201 的法國病人續用，收案上限 5 人、不新招募，75 mg 每日兩次口服，初期 12 個月，主要指標為安全性與耐受性，站點為土魯斯、波爾多、馬賽、巴黎。PubMed 近 7 天無未收錄之 MSA 標題論文（唯一新命中為 PSP／PD／MSA 鑑別影像的期刊評論，無摘要、暫不收錄）。

en.body: Added 1 trial: Alterity's open-label extension ATH434-203 (NCT07729852, registered 2026/07) — continued access for French patients who completed ATH434-201 only, capped at 5 participants with no new recruitment, 75 mg orally twice daily for an initial 12 months, with safety and tolerability as the primary endpoints, at sites in Toulouse, Bordeaux, Marseille and Paris. PubMed showed no unrecorded MSA-titled papers in the last 7 days (the one new hit was a journal editorial on differentiating PSP, PD and MSA by imaging, with no abstract, so it was not added).

body: 新增 1 則文獻：小腦萎縮經由認知功能影響 MSA 步態凍結（CNS Neurosci Ther，武漢大學人民醫院，n=106）——Crus II 萎縮可獨立預測 N-FOGQ 分數，執行功能與注意力缺損為中介因子。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 適應症逐筆確認後無新療法試驗或狀態變更。

en.body: Added 1 paper: cerebellar atrophy influences freezing of gait in MSA through cognitive dysfunction (CNS Neurosci Ther, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University, n=106) — Crus II atrophy independently predicted N-FOGQ scores, mediated by executive-function and attention deficits. A study-by-study check of the last 7 days on CT.gov found no new MSA therapy trials or status changes.

body: 新增 2 則文獻：UK Biobank 巢式病例對照研究（Mov Disord，114 例新發 MSA；居住鄉村為唯一隨潛伏期增強的暴露，5 年窗 OR 2.73）與因斯布魯克團隊領域綜論（J Neural Transm，指出 α-synuclein 標的治療迄今未展現一致臨床效益）。更新 Alterity ATH434 一列：2026/07/07 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄確認註冊路徑（Ph3 約 200 人、主要終點 11 項 UMSARS Part I、單一樞紐試驗＋確認性證據），並加入領域焦點一則。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 適應症逐筆確認後無新療法試驗（其餘命中為肌少症、PSP 遠距監測等非 MSA 療法研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers: a UK Biobank nested case-control study (Mov Disord; 114 incident MSA cases, with rural living the only exposure that strengthened with latency, 5-year OR 2.73) and a field review from the Innsbruck group (J Neural Transm, noting that α-synuclein-targeted therapies have not yet shown consistent clinical benefit). Updated the Alterity ATH434 row: FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes announced 2026/07/07 confirmed the registrational pathway (Ph3 of ~200 patients, 11-item UMSARS Part I primary endpoint, single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence), and added a matching field-focus item. A study-by-study check of the last 7 days on CT.gov found no new MSA therapy trials (other hits were sarcopenia, PSP remote monitoring and similar non-MSA studies).

body: 新增 1 篇文獻（Cell：TPPP/p25 類澱粉種子活性作為 MSA 專一性生物標記）。CT.gov 掃描未見在研療法新進者——新登錄的 Synusight SST001（NCT07604116）為 PET 造影示蹤劑、非治療藥物，依準則不收錄。

en.body: Added 1 paper (Cell: TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity as a specific biomarker for MSA). The CT.gov sweep surfaced no new investigational therapy — the newly registered Synusight SST001 (NCT07604116) is a PET imaging tracer, not a therapeutic, and is excluded per the inclusion criteria.

body: 新增 2 篇文獻（QSM 黑質磁化率／體積比之 PSP/PD/MSA 鑑別、MSA 不隨意吸氣性歎息與腦血流研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers (QSM substantia-nigra susceptibility-to-volume ratio for PSP/PD/MSA discrimination, and involuntary inspiratory sighing with cerebral blood flow in MSA).

body: MSA-IQ 情報站上線：收錄 11 個在研療法／學術案、8 個臨床試驗、9 筆試驗讀出、4 項評估量表、3 個自然史世代、3 則機轉與臨床前重點、9 篇近期文獻，全部附可查證來源、中英雙語。

en.body: MSA-IQ went live: 11 therapies and academic programmes, 8 clinical trials, 9 trial readouts, 4 rating scales, 3 natural-history cohorts, 3 mechanism/preclinical topics and 9 recent papers — every entry sourced, in both Chinese and English.
